brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: a base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: 3-piece base (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full) with 2 removable bins: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-div2 (2-compartment for small parts organization)

finish.summary: Portable electronics organizer built as compact L-shaped 3-cell base. Two removable bins provide small-parts storage (one standard, one 2-compartment divided). Notch drawer frame at 1,1 provides drawer storage. Full cover with handle on third cell provides carry handle. Joint bolts secure structure, meshClash clear.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
